title: Minka House
description: A seaside house in the Ito Region. Prerequisite: Blue Stamp Access Cost: 450,000 CR Perks: - Credit Stunts - You earn an extra 10% Credits in Horizon Stunt Party Events.

title: Hakusan Mountain Lodge
description: A mountain lodge in the high alps of the Sotoyama Region. Prerequisite: Pink Stamp Access Cost: 635,000 CR Perks: - Additional Garage Slot - Adds the ability to place +1 Display Car Locator - Cool Credits - You earn an extra 10% Credits in Horizon Life Events.

title: Tokyo House
description: A Japanese house on the outskirts of Tokyo City with a four-car garage. Cost: 3,000,000 CR (free with VIP pass) Perks: - Daily Wheelspin - Get a free Wheelspin each day you attend Horizon Japan.

title: Fuji Unkai House
description: A classically styled Japanese house with an unmatched view of Mount Fuji. Prerequisite: Orange Stamp Access Cost: 830,000 CR Perks: - Career Driver - You earn an extra 10% Credits when completing Horizon Jobs.

title: Soko 78
description: A spacious warehouse in the Tokyo City docklands. Prerequisite: Purple Stamp Access Cost: 980,000 CR Perks: - Import/Export - You pay 5% less Credits when purchasing cars from the Autoshow.

title: Vision House
description: An architectural masterpiece, with a view of Tokyo City. Prerequisite: Gold Stamp Access Cost: 1,500,000 CR Perks: - Driving With Friends - You earn an extra 10% Skill Score when doing LINK Skills. - Additional Garage Slot - Adds the ability to place +1 Display Car Locator.

title: Wind Farm Cross-Country
description: This Cross-Country route has it all: rough, uneven terrain; big jumps; water splashes; and a final dash along the sand to the finish. Restriction: Class C 500 Pickups & 4x4s

title: Temple Cross-Country
description: Starting at the Horizon Festival, carve your way through the steep banked turns and aim for a perfect landing as you fly towards the final stretch. Prerequisite: Yellow Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Total AWD

title: Stadium Cross-Country Circuit
description: Race in and around the Horizon Stadium as you tackle the custom-built raised roads, crossovers and huge jumps. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Total Rally

title: City Docks Cross-Country Circuit
description: The Tokyo City Docks are the star here. Weave through shipping containers around this sharp-cornered circuit. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Total Rally

title: Shinjuku Gyoen Cross-Country
description: Race towards Tokyo City cutting Cross-Country through water sections and over daring jumps. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Heavy Hitters

title: Shimanoyama Cross-Country
description: Cut through the long grass of the Shimanoyama Region before bursting into the Horizon Stadium to wow the crowds as you speed up the raised platforms. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Sports Utility Heroes

title: Oka Cross-Country Circuit
description: Traverse the underpasses in the Hokubu Region around this short but fast circuit. Watch for those banks and jumps. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Unlimited Off-Road

title: Snow Forest Cross-Country Circuit
description: Take on the slopes around the Sotoyama Ski Resort in this fast-paced Cross-Country Circuit. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total Buggies & Off-Road

title: Takashiro Cross-Country
description: Hurtle off-road through the Takashiro Region taking on sweeping banked turns, steep inclines and a full-tilt downhill charge to the finish. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total Buggies & Off-Road

title: Soni Highlands Cross-Country
description: Charge across the Takashiro and Hokubu Regions over mixed terrain and one of the most breathtaking jumps at Horizon Japan. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total Buggies & Off-Road

title: Naruo Cross-Country Circuit
description: Fly like an eagle as you tear around the fairways of the Naruo Golf Course. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Unlimited Buggies

title: Nangan Cross-Country Circuit
description: Take on huge jumps and long, sweeping banked corners as you circle around Irokawa Space Centre. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Modern Rally Cars

title: Izu Cross-Country
description: After an exhilarating freefall drop through the Kawazu Nandaru Loop Bridge you'll be fighting for traction on the long open corners. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Sports Utility Heroes

title: Yahikoyama Cross-Country
description: Wide, flowing turns through the flower fields before touching down on Ito Airfield for a twisting race to the finish. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Unlimited Off-Road

title: Edogawa Cross-Country Circuit
description: Race around Tokyo City as you tackle jumps, split carriageways and a trick final hairpin that can make or break your race position. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Sports Utility Heroes

title: Ruriko-ji Cross-Country
description: Charge down the Sotoyama ski runs before free-falling into the Takashiro Region and going fully off-road. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Unlimited Off-Road

title: Tateyama Alpine Cross-Country
description: Descend from the snowy Sotoyama Region before lining up for a series of jumps across the plains to finish. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Total Buggies & Off-Road

title: Legend Island Cross-Country Circuit
description: Contend with the terrain on Legend Island as you leap off hills and drift around tight corners. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Pickups & 4x4s

title: The Titan
description: The ultimate Cross-Country Race spanning across several regions. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Total Buggies & Off-Road

title: Airfield Trail
description: Navigate the uneven loose surfaces as you head near the airfield for a high-speed push on the asphalt roads to the finish. Prerequisite: Yellow Wristband Access Restriction: Class C 500 Total Rally

title: Taiyaki Scramble
description: Elevation changes and fast corner sequences make up this unique fish-shaped scramble. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B Total Rally

title: Sekibe Scramble
description: Rough terrain awaits you on this slalom-like scramble. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Evo vs Impreza

title: Kinkaku-ji Trail
description: This trail leads through a valley of trees and past Kinkaku-ji Temple, before entering into an asphalt sprint to the finish. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Total Rally

title: Chiheisen Scramble
description: A fast lap at the Horizon Festival Site mixing grippy asphalt and loose gravel sections. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Total AWD

title: Horizon Stadium Scramble
description: A mixed-surface loop around the Horizon Stadium's perimeter. Watch your braking point into these deceptive turns. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Modern Rally Cars

title: Waterfall Trail
description: Charting upwards toward the Sotoyama Region, this twisting trail has multiple water sections that cut across the loose gravel roads. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total AWD

title: Sotoyama Scramble
description: Race on the asphalt and on loose surfaces around the Sotoyama Ski Resort. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Retro Rally Cars

title: Hirosaki Scramble
description: Launching into a lap on the asphalt before heading around the outside of Hirosaki Castle on the gravel roads. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total Buggies & Off-Road

title: Takashiro Trail
description: With bumps, jumps, twists, and turns, this trail is a rollercoaster ride from the Takashiro Region to the Hokubu Region. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Unlimited Off-Road

title: Hokubu Trail
description: A full-tilt forest run with fast corners and thrilling downhill sections on this bumpy road. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Rally Monsters

title: Kawazu Nandaru Scramble
description: Head up the iconic Kawazu Nandaru Loop Bridge and then full throttle back down the gravel roads. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Modern Rally Cars

title: Bamboo Forest Scramble
description: Take on high-speed sections and tricky corners in this lap that passes through the Ito Region's stunning bamboo groves. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Class S1 800 Total Rally

title: Ine Scramble
description: Starting and ending on the asphalt, this quickly becomes a test of cornering on the rougher terrain. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Modern Rally Cars

title: Sunflower Scramble
description: Breathtaking flat-out sections, technically demanding turns and mixed-surface transitions put you to the test in this wild scramble. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Class S1 800 Rally Monsters

title: Cherry Field Trail
description: A breathtaking downhill charge into some tricky corners will test your ability to brake as late as you dare to gain an advantage. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Total Rally

title: Oyashirazu Trail
description: A challenging trail that mixes flat-out speed sections with sudden technical corner sequences. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Classic Rally Cars

title: Ito Trail
description: Taking you through the top of the Ito Region, this trail offers challenging corners before descending towards the coastline. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Rally Monsters

title: Nukabira Trail
description: A hill climb leads high up into the Sotoyama Region before a breathless downhill charge on the back half of the Trail. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Total Rally

title: Legend Island Trail
description: This trail will take you across Legend Island as you battle for position on the tricky mixed-surface roads. Stay sharp. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Total Rally

title: The Gauntlet
description: A trail that stretches across the horizon, endurance is your friend here. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Rally Monsters

title: Horizon Festival Drag Strip
description: Hit your top speed on the drag strip at the Horizon Festival Site. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Anything Goes

title: Irokawa Space Centre Drag Strip
description: This drag strip runs alongside the Irokawa Space Centre. Launch it! Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Anything Goes

title: Ito Airfield Drag Strip
description: Fly high with this drag strip on the Ito Airfield runway. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Anything Goes

title: Shirakawa Circuit
description: A short technical circuit with plenty of long, sweeping corners that keep the pace fast. Restriction: Class C 500 Retro Sports Cars

title: Daikoku Circuit
description: The extra wide roads on this fast-paced circuit provide plenty of opportunities to overtake. Prerequisite: Yellow Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Total Sports Cars

title: Tokyo Railway Sprint
description: This point-to-point sprint through Tokyo City requires on-rails cornering ability to get ahead of the pack. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Country: Japan

title: Festival Sprint
description: A scenic point-to-point run that speeds right through the Horizon Festival Site and out the other side. Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Class B 600 Super Hot Hatch Cars

title: Shimanoyama Circuit
description: A purpose-built Drift circuit that always draws a crowd with its free-flowing turns. Send it! Prerequisite: Green Wristband Access Restriction: Eclectic Domestics

title: Irokawa Circuit
description: Prepare for take-off as you loop around the Irokawa Space Centre! Get ready to hit the brakes for the hairpin after the steep downhill section. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Eclectic Domestics

title: Narai-Juku Circuit
description: A quick circuit that favours an aggressive cornering approach to build momentum lap on lap. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total Supercars

title: Shikisai Sprint
description: Cut a winding path through the Hokubu Region and under the highways before looping back. Prerequisite: Blue Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Modern Super Saloons

title: Venus Sprint
description: Tame the narrow, twisting mountain road from the Takashiro Region up towards the Sotoyama Region. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total Muscle

title: Coastline Sprint
description: Twist and turn through the Nangan Region before hitting a flat-out back half towards Tokyo City. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Modern Super Saloons

title: Electric Town Circuit
description: Expect long straights and square corners in this whistle-stop tour around Tokyo City. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Modern Sports Cars

title: Satta Sprint
description: A flat-out charge through the Ito Region to really test your nerve and control at top speeds. Prerequisite: Pink Wristband Access Restriction: Class A 700 Total Supercars

title: Highway Circuit
description: A full-throttle lap of the Highway Loop around Tokyo City. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Class S1 800 Super GT

title: Ito Sprint
description: This run twists and turns along the coastal roads of the Ito Region. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Class S1 800 Modern Supercars

title: Hokubu Circuit
description: This fast-paced circuit is nestled within a forest and is perfect for setting some serious lap times. Prerequisite: Orange Wristband Access Restriction: Class S1 800 Track Toys

title: Shimanoyama Sprint
description: Head along the coastal roads before a very sharp right turn as you race through the Shimanoyama Region. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Class S2 900 Extreme Track Toys

title: Soni Circuit
description: Twist and turn your way around this circuit as the sharp corners and elevation changes keep you on your toes. Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access Restriction: Class S2 900 Track Life

title: The Goliath
description: A lap around the entire perimeter of Japan. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Class R 998 Track Life

title: Legend Island Circuit
description: Built for Legends. The circuit where only the best of the best can take on its challenging turns and blazing fast pace. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Class R 998 Track Life

title: Seaside Park Sprint
description: This point-to-point route passes through Legend Island; a mix of flat-out speed and sudden tight turns demand the driver's full focus. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Hypercars

title: The Colossus
description: One colossal lap around the entire highway loop. Prerequisite: Gold Wristband Access Restriction: Class S2 900 Hypercars

title: Tateyama Kurobe Sprint
description: A fast-paced point-to-point run that passes through the Tateyama Kurobe Snow Corridor. Restriction: Class S2 900 Hypercars Prerequisite: Purple Wristband Access

title: Rainbow Bridge Descent
description: Take on the competition around the Tokyo City streets before putting your foot down on the Rainbow Bridge.

title: Daikoku Chase
description: Starting at the Daikoku Parking Area you'll race around the surrounding highway. Stay in your lane and pass through the checkpoints.

title: Tokyo City Docks Charge
description: Weave through the Tokyo City Docks' maze of square corners before a high-speed race to the finish.

title: Minami Chase
description: Race across the plains at night before tackling some tight hairpins and descending into Tokyo City.

title: Matsumi Climb
description: A race with many exciting twists and turns as you speed toward the Matsumi Great Bridge.

title: Shimanoyama Charge
description: Get ahead early and take advantage of the long straights in this high-speed thriller.

title: Festival Chase
description: Speed away from the Horizon Festival as you quickly descend through the forest. Pay extra attention to your road position across the raised road.

title: River Descent
description: After some sharp hairpin turns at the start, let loose as you race along the river's edge.

title: Cedar Run
description: Race flat out through the Minamino Region's fast-paced roads as you head towards the Tokyo City Docks.

title: Kita Ine
description: Master the square turns to gain an advantage in this race from Ito Airfield to the coast.

title: Sunflower Charge
description: Race across part of the sprawling highway before turning your attention to the cliffside tunnels.

title: Nachi Run
description: Race along the mountain roads around the Takashiro Region with its challenging high-speed runs and sudden corners.

title: Hokubu Ascent
description: Race up through the forest roads around the Hokubu Region. Stay on the asphalt and watch out for some very sharp turns.

title: Okishinaimura Run
description: Watch your braking and road position as you take on a route dominated by tricky hairpins.

title: Norikura Descent
description: You'll need to time your overtaking manoeuvres perfectly as you take on these narrow, winding mountain roads.

title: Hakone Nanamagari
description: This iconic road offers up a relentless sequence of hairpins to test your cornering ability. Restriction: Class B 600

title: Arashiyama Takao
description: This route carves a high-speed path through the forest, with sudden sharp turns to keep you switched on. Restriction: Class S2 900

title: Mt. Haruna
description: The Mt. Haruna Touge is a perfect balance of technical cornering and flat-out speed. Restriction: Class B 600

title: Norikura Skyline
description: This high-altitude route descends through a demanding sequence of turns and high-speed sections. Restriction: Class S1 800

title: Bandai Azuma
description: A fast-paced scenic sprint where you'll need flat-out speed on the straights and to brake as late as you dare on the turns. Restriction: Class A 700
